title: Retire the Installed Apps view once objectstack#23933 retargets the entry: drop the `marketplace:installed-list` registration, InstalledListWidget, both `system/marketplace/installed` routes and the `MarketplaceInstalledPage` export
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23933

carries the retirement half of objectui#12675 (ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23892, record `6216295104`, item 2: "the separate Installed Apps view retires once the filtered view serves its actions"). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`), as answer A to open question 3 of the dev report on objectui#12675 (`6218334568`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why it waits

objectstack's served `marketplace_installed` page (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts`) still renders this repo's `marketplace:installed-list` widget. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12722 made that widget redirect to `/apps/APP/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace`, so the published entry keeps working. The widget and the export can only go after objectstack-ai/objectstack#23933 points the plugin's Installed Apps entry at the Packages URL directly, and after objectstack's `.objectui-sha` carries objectui#12675.

## The work, once unblocked

- Remove the `marketplace:installed-list` registration and `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx`.
- Remove both `system/marketplace/installed` routes in `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` (the no-active-app block and the app block).
- Remove the `MarketplaceInstalledPage` export from `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, together with the file.
- Point MarketplacePage's "Installed (N)" button straight at the Packages URL. It reaches Packages through the legacy redirect today; that file was objectui#12606's (PR #12662) at #12675's time.
- Per the four axes this retires immediately, with no staged window. It is a narrowing of published surfaces (an export, a registered widget, routes), so it owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review and its claim reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

## Done when

No source, test or doc in objectui names `marketplace:installed-list`, `InstalledListWidget` or `MarketplaceInstalledPage`. The "Installed (N)" button lands on the filtered Packages URL. objectstack's served pages no longer reference the widget (read at the pin).

Dedupe: objectui open issues read for `InstalledListWidget`, `MarketplaceInstalledPage`, `marketplace:installed-list` and "Installed Apps retire": none, as the contract review on PR #12722 (`6219326691`) also recorded.
